method.method_draft: Use an explicit cube-orientation table. Starting with A at position 1, update the bottom face after each roll: a roll right makes the old right face become bottom, and a roll upward makes the old upper/north face become bottom. Applying the move sequence R,R,U,R,U,R gives the same bottom-face label at positions 1 and 6, so those two positions were occupied by the same cube face.
